title: Carbon Trap Shino with Joe Hicks
source_quote: Carbon Trap Shino with Joe Hicks Sat. October 3, 12-5 PM ... You will then glaze your work choosing between four shino glazes and then load it into District Clay's reduction kiln for a special carbon trap firing on Sunday.
evidence_sentence: The homepage describes a half-day workshop on October 3 with a special carbon trap firing on October 4 in a reduction kiln.
evidence_quote: load it into District Clay's reduction kiln for a special carbon trap firing on Sunday. You are invited to observe (through social media or in person) the firing on Sunday, October 4th.
summary: A workshop on Saturday October 3 (12–5 PM) learning to make and apply carbon trap shino glazes, followed by a reduction kiln firing on Sunday October 4 that you can observe.
commitment: Sat 12-5 PM glaze · Sun Oct 4 firing observation
